row: Dr. Kristen Turner is a board-certified veterinarian specializing in exotic companion mammal practice. With a focus on education and improving access to care for exotic pets, she empowers general practice veterinarians to get out of their comfort zone and start seeing exotic animal patients. Over 20 DVMs have taken her flagship CE course, Exotic Vet Med Essentials, a 12-hour interactive RACE-approved program designed to fast-track vets to seeing exotic patients in their practice. You can expect videos and shorts covering a variety of topics designed to guide veterinarians when an exotic patient walks into their practice, from triage and emergency stabilization to preventative care to surgical tips and tricks. Whether you are a recent graduate brand new to exotics, or a seasoned veterinarian, Dr. Turner offers her expertise to help you treat ALL of your exotic patients.
